notes.title: Our new horror co-op game!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

It's been quite a while now since we released Psych from Early Access along with the last and fifth chapter. We've watched a lot of videos, opinions and feedback and we're very happy that it was so well received! Once again, we were able to learn a lot and gather a lot of ideas. There may be more translations to come in the future, but for now we have something we'd like to share with you.... our new project!

We would like to invite you to Midnight Heist, a co-op horror adventure game where you can go on a heist alone or with up to three other friends as a novice hacker! You can already visit Midnight Heist's Steam page and add it to your wishlist so you don't miss the upcoming release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2204350/Midnight_Heist/

With Midnight Heist, we want to create an entirely new co-op experience that takes consistent and, most importantly, fun elements from previous games and combines them with interesting innovations. With the two main themes of hackers and thieves, which we think go very well together, we want to offer a unique gaming experience. Through Psych, we have been able to gain a lot of experience to now create a great multiplayer game better than ever, together with you, our community. On the Steam page you can find all further information, which we will constantly update during the development. Features will change and improve over time as we are in the middle of development, however, as with Psych, we will involve you heavily and introduce things one by one to build on your feedback.

We're really looking forward to showing you more soon!

Until then,
Dan and Andreas

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/92f5d8851f3089e0c5759ef119707d59a001b1be.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Savepoints & Performance

notes.title: Update V1.0.1 – More languages & bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello together!

As announced, we have added the languages Russian, Turkish and Spanish and fixed some of the bugs you reported, such as the disappearance of the power box in the power house. 

In the next update, which will come in the next few days, we will fix the save points in the sewers and add more in the first part.

We will of course continue to listen to your feedback and possibly add more languages in the future, but for now we are working on the next project, about which we will have more information very soon!

Thank you and we hope you enjoy playing Psych!

notes.title: FINAL CHAPTER OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Chapter 5[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The time has finally come. We are releasing the final chapter of Psych, which will not only reveal the secrets behind Alex and Sam's story, but will also have a few surprises in store for you. We have learned from past chapters and wanted to give you much more impact than game time, so the fifth chapter, as previously announced, is not too long at about half an hour. Nevertheless, we have brought a lot of other improvements with this update, not only visual ones like even higher resolution textures or new details in the world of Psych, but also translations! You can currently play Psych in the following languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] German
[*] Chinese
[*] Czech
[/list]
For the other languages, the translations are already done, but still need to be added, which will happen very very soon. The following languages are affected:
[list]
[*] Turkish
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[/list]
Although we have taken the greatest care, we would like to ask you for your feedback! In order to find possibly overlooked bugs or to make further improvements in general. We expect at least one more update for Psych, which should improve the game experience and introduce the languages mentioned above.

[h3]Now let's move on to the content:[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
The biggest question that many people have already asked themselves is what can come next. Many thought at the end of the fourth chapter that this was already the end, but you will certainly be very surprised when you jump into the last chapter to find out the truth. We won't spoil anything here, but we can already tell you the following: There will be [b]new locations[/b], [b]new characters[/b] and completely [b]new twists[/b] in the story.

We are already incredibly excited about your opinions and feedback on this update! We can hardly believe that we have finally managed to create an approximately three-hour psychological horror thriller together with you, the community. We are very proud of our work together and have learned an immense amount in the development of Psych. This will be a great help to us in our future projects.

Last but not least, we would like to thank you again for accompanying us on this journey and for being a part of the community. Psych wouldn't be Psych without you, and the feedback you always give us is really worth its weight in gold.

Please don't forget to rate Psych on Steam, it helps us as developers enormously!

Until then, have fun and see you soon!
Dan and Andreas

[h3]Addendum:[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
The release would have actually been yesterday, October 21, 2022, but since there was a technical error and Psych disappeared from the Steam Store, the release has been postponed to today, October 22, 2022 - which means Psych is now fully available!

notes.title: Psych Full Release Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We have great news to share with you. The development of the last chapter is going very well, so we have set a strict target to release version 1.0 including Chapter 5 on October 21, 2022. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/9933e90284d0c488599271b39152f02d04283f62.png[/img]

[h2]Chapter 5[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[i]*Warning, this section might contain some spoilers*[/i]

In this chapter, Alex uncovers the truth and faces unpleasant surprises that you, as the player, will have to experience. Some things will happen that you certainly won't expect. We're really excited to share the final chapter of Psych with you! Here's a sneak peek of the upcoming update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/884dc8aaaaa8f1f37696631c646eece9fc9aabd1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/ba874e03a98b30ae27829d6d335432b4bd06b19f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/9c0b910a3c21b8854b6814f7f9637ee005ecc4b6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/84ae4e394729f56432a2c23cc56cb88d9b83322b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/457875b2abc9cf82f21e54b70425ef688ebfbb29.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improvements [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We were able to make some improvements during development and fix all known bugs. The improvements gave us significantly more performance. In the park, we have an average of 30% more FPS, which will be especially noticeable on weaker systems. In addition, we have further enhanced some locations. We improved the quality of some textures with the help of AI to create a graphically even better experience. Last but not least, we will also be able to offer controller support with the full release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/394ba8ed63c2b3f791a21851b9dd94f7153416ce.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/acb31f3763a62813b6ead37915a8f33b678d46a5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Translations[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We also currently translating Psych into the following languages:
[list]
[*]German
[*]Chinese
[*]Turkish 
[*]Spanish
[*]Czech
[*]Russian
[/list]
[h2]After Version 1.0[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Of course, we will continue to respond to feedback, suggestions and bugs after the release of the final chapter. We pay attention to every opinion, because after all the community is working together with us on Psych. Psych will finally leave the Early Access status after the upcoming update and will be considered a full title. We will not be raising the price, as we feel that we have hit a good price point with Psych.

[h2]Future projects[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As in previously written announcements, something big will come after Psych. We can't give more details yet, but we are incredibly motivated and bursting with ideas. It won't be long after the release of the fifth chapter before you hear from us again, that much we can reveal!

[h3]Thank you![/h3]
Finally, we would like to thank you for the incredible time. To every support, to every opinion, to every feedback and of course to all the people from the community who played Psych. It's still our first big title and we can be really proud that we've brought together such a wonderful community. Thank you so very, very much!

Dan and Andreas

notes.title: Chapter 4 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Chapter 4[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The time has finally come, we can finally introduce you to Chapter 4. As described in the previous announcement, you can expect new as well as old locations and a lot of new content concerning the story of Alex and Sam. We focused on more variety and more storytelling in this chapter and are very happy with the result so far. We hope you will be too! This is one of our last updates on Psych as we move towards the finish line together with you and wrap up the story with Chapter 5. We also have the following information for you:

[h3]Screenshots[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/b3c884055cc7fefb55717e91f5de47db79c18cfb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/bfb8f8b4ebd5b2cc95d2e2f85c9fc856fd460dc8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/304eb39e9bf007de4a0e51e8211dc37bb95e2573.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/2e5568557294e13638080aec2bbc625c4b04362b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Chapter 5[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Chapter 5 of Psych will not be as long as Chapter 3 or 4 in terms of game length, but it will contain a big bang that we are quite sure will shock you. We have prepared an ending that no one has expected yet. In exchange for the fifth chapter not being so long, we will make improvements and add new features to the previous content. We want to add more details to the park, add a few new secrets, create new achievements to unlock and also offer translations as well as full controller support. In short, this means that for the grand finale of Psych, we'll be tackling technical improvements and making your existing game experience even better! Of course, your feedback is absolutely important to us. We would like to release chapter 5 and thus the last update for Psych in September 2022. As soon as chapter 4 is published, please send us your opinions and suggestions for improvement. We are incredibly excited to finish Psych with you soon and move on to the next project!

Thanks again for accompanying us up to this point and supporting us with numerous ideas, suggestions for improvement and with your understanding! We really hope you like chapter 4 and are looking forward to your opinions, experiences and videos!

Until then,
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: Chapter 4 Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

Today we have a lot of information about the development of the fourth chapter of Psych and some sneak peeks.

First of all, we would like to sincerely apologize for not being able to keep the announced release date. Many of you don't know that much about us (MediaTale), the team behind Psych. Only one person is actively working with the game engine Unity, which is used to develop Psych. In the past few weeks, new development tools have been tried out, which should make development more efficient and fun in the long run. However, such internal restructuring takes some time, but it will definitely be worth it in the future. Nevertheless, we are working day by day and listening to every single feedback in order to provide you with the best possible game experience.

We had planned to be ready with the fourth chapter by the end of April at the latest, but now we have to postpone it until July at the latest in order to be able to deliver all of our planned content. Many of you have already shown great understanding and we hope that you can be patient a little longer this time too. We thank you very much in advance!

[h2]Now we come to the fourth chapter of Psych:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[i]*Warning, this section might contain some spoilers for people who haven't played the third chapter yet*[/i]

When Alex found an exit to the underground in the sewers, he barely avoided the train. He lost consciousness. However, the strong urge to find his sister Sam made him wake up quickly. Alex now finds himself in a completely new environment where he is in for some very nasty surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/df99c7aea48e003834f42465145ec3daac43fee7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/e3e26ca6eb9cd99bc3b0a0f27ccb3db8f92b4a5a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/03e17cdd021e03eb32546bee5bcd446844eabb89.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/c1c540a561aa3fec7c71e715911db66a12ac8d72.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/aad5bdf3ebae4c20826ece46da7c6ac4f9e7a6dd.png[/img]

Some things in the fourth chapter make Alex realize something. Something that he himself does not want to believe. He does everything he can to find Sam. Alex is back in his flat when the doorbell suddenly starts ringing in the middle of the night. He hears a giggle. A strange but nevertheless very familiar giggle. Is it... Sam?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/34d466300e1dca83eafd934bbe6a0e1a326a0d16.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/ce6f31c09238361dd6751dc7db5e84ea8aee3c04.png[/img]

For the fourth chapter we have implemented some features that we hope you will enjoy. One of them, for example, you can see here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/4713460da2194c181f50805f6ab35c40861ed0f1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/dd84cc95b9ece17d7565e22fc4a6636e62c1ba58.png[/img]

In addition to important story sections, there will also be more horror, a familiar face returns that you won't want to look into on purpose.

[hr][/hr]
I hope you're as excited as we are about the upcoming releases of Chapters 4 and 5! We also have a little announcement for you at the end of this release: Once all the chapters of Psych have been released and Sam has been found, there won't be a moment for you to catch your breath. Be prepared for something big in our journey together...

Until then, thank you, enjoy playing and feel free to keep sending us feedback on the existing chapters! If you haven't rated Psych on Steam yet, we would really appreciate a positive review, it really helps us out!

Dan and Andreas

notes.title: Update V0.4.0 – Chapter Selection
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

before we fully focus on chapter 4, we decided to publish a small update with ideas from the community. It was suggested that you can select the individual chapters in the main menu to play them again without having to start from the beginning:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/3567b9d107e2ab18e47609b2c77a11120166386c.png[/img]

Once you have unlocked a chapter, you can select it from the menu at any time. Please note, however, that if you press "New Game", all progress will be lost. This also applies to the unlocked chapters. So if you want to start from the beginning without losing your progress, please select "Chapter 1" in the selection.

Furthermore, we have made a few small changes in chapter 3, which are not mentioned here for spoiler reasons. The performance has also been improved in some areas and should be noticeable for players with weaker systems.

Feel free to send us more suggestions and ideas so that we can implement them in future updates! We can't say it often enough, but: Your feedback is incredibly important!

Until then, have fun with Psych, and we'll get back to work on Chapter 4!

See you soon,
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: Update V0.3.5 – New Content & Story
notes.content:
[h2]Hello together![/h2]

We've taken a close look at your feedback on the latest content update that Chapter 3 brought. From improvements to navigation through the sewers to even more story content and more horror, it's all there. Now we're ready to share all the improvements you've asked for. We would like to take this opportunity to remind you that your feedback always comes first. We are very grateful for the community we have built up to this point! So here are the new improvements for update 0.3.5:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/25c42ea0a50e1cdce6fec0bd4e7bc7f9c7166da5.png[/img]

[h3]Back in the Park[/h3]
[list]
[*] Quest descriptions are now clearer and more helpful 
[*] The problem with the camera going crazy during chess has been fixed
[/list]

[h3]Alex's flat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the UI text not to disappear when reading the mail
[*] Alex's computer is now facing the right way
[*] The time on the mobile phone is now correct
[/list]

[h3]In the sewers[/h3]
[list]
[*] The flashlight is now brighter and lights farther
[*] Timed puzzles now have an hearable timer
[*] The generator room has been reworked
[*] New events and scenarios have been added
[*] New horror elements have been added
[*] A map to pick up has been added
[*] Cutscenes have been added
[*] Many new sound effects have been added
[*] New side story content has been added
[*] Some sound effects have been adjusted in volume
[*] The sewer has been reworked from the map design for easier navigation. Coloured markers now show the way
[*] The escalation system has been reworked and has more sound effects
[*] A pop-up tutorial now appears for the escalation system
[*] There is now an acoustic signal when all valves are put together
[*] Voice lines have been added to help the player in some sections
[*] Fixed a bug where the icon for opening doors did not disappear
[/list]

Once again, we ask for your feedback to bring more improvements in the future!

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
We will continue with the work on the fourth chapter. We have some new features planned with the next chapter, which will again bring more mechanics and more variety. Expect the update in about 1-2 months. Behind the scenes, we are also experimenting a lot with network technology, for a yet unreleased project. 

Thank you very much for your attention and have fun playing! See you soon!

Dan and Andreas from MediaTale

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]
[hr][/hr]
It's been a few days since we published chapter 3 of Psych. Many of you have jumped straight into the new content and shared it with others on Youtube or Twitch. There was a lot of praise, but also some constructive criticism and other feedback that we want to thank you for. We deliberately decided to release a story game as an Early Access version in order to get the game into the right shape together with you and to respond to feedback and suggestions as promptly as possible. What you tell us always comes first for us. We want to be an indie developer whose community is at the forefront of game development. We have analysed your ideas and suggestions and are already planning new content and improvements for the third chapter. These include things like:

[list]
[*]Improving navigation through the sewers with a map you can find and by highlighting some level design elements
[*]More story elements to accompany you as you scurry around
[*]More varied events and associated puzzles
[*]Enhancing the atmosphere even further
[*]Upgrades to the flashlight that can be found in the course of the third chapter such as a higher brightness or an extended light cone
[*]Revision of the escalation system (the mechanic where you have to close your eyes) by explaining the system better and adding numerous additions to it
[*]And much more…
[/list]

Of course, the upcoming update will also eliminate the existing bugs, which fortunately were very rare. The game time may also increase a little with the update, as there will be more content. We very much hope that with these improvements we can make the third chapter even better together with you before we move on to the fourth chapter.

With two developers, one of whom still has a full time job, it is very difficult to release big content for Psych in a predictable time frame. We like to take our time to be happy ourselves with the content we present to you. That's why we are grateful for every feedback and suggestion you give us, which helps us to make Psych a little bit better every time!

Furthermore, we will also be releasing our own Steam Trading Cards, Backgrounds, Emotes and Badges for Psych as soon as possible! Since we were verified some time ago, we are now authorised to create these!

We would like to take this opportunity to thank you for an incredible 2021. From the demo of Psych to the release in September, it was a very nice time together with you, which we hope to have again next year!

[hr][/hr]
[b]We wish you a happy new year, stay healthy and see you soon![/b]

– Dan and Andreas from MediaTale

notes.title: Chapter 3 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Chapter 3[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
The time has come! We have finally reached the point of sharing the third chapter of Psych with you. We have a lot of new content to show! First, let's start with the locations of the action. The third chapter now takes place in three locations. The park you've already met, Alex's flat where you travel back in time and finally the underground where a creepy surprise awaits you. Not only are the locations new, but also many game mechanics. While you had to fight with your own sanity in the park, there are other things to do in the course of the third chapter. New puzzles require a bit of skill and brains to solve. Here we have taken special care to bring in as much variation as possible. The puzzles now consist of divided, smaller puzzles that always require a different approach in order to progress. Sometimes you have to be quick to solve a puzzle, but sometimes you need to be calm. At the same time, the horror factor has been increased significantly with numerous new sounds, new atmosphere and an unknown, threatening presence as we desperately search for Sam. We want to offer you a lot of variety for a high level of fun, where no step is the same as the next. At the same time, we learn more and more through the many clues what is going on in Psych and what is going on with Alex.

Here you can get some insights into the third chapter:
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/ce1d3cd20c0f2dc36f50b81c89b436d2625548cb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/f3bd924874e309acb3eeab604ef04a856deef723.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/216c62c103b3289f58359f8c894620aefbc588a2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/4b7880e83fc265eae711eabbb1acd8068bc0546b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/c24284d0075b213de14ec3ba9918a1b8db377672.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/09ca2ee1c334d9eb87e6d66a8642f78facedbfc8.png[/img]

We sincerely hope that you will enjoy the third chapter. We will continue to release improvements and new content that will make the gameplay of Psych even better. Feel free to give us feedback on the new chapter in the Steam discussions, on Twitter or via email, or if you have any suggestions on what we can do better!

Thank you so much for being so understanding about the delay of the update. It shows us what a wonderful community Psych has behind it!

[h3]What happens next?[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
After a little time off with our families (which we hope you'll have too), we'll get straight back to analysing your feedback. Based on this, we will make changes that will make Psych even better. If any bugs are found, which we hope to have ironed out ourselves, we will fix them as soon as possible.
The third update will have the version name 0.3. We are aiming for more content and improvements in a 0.3.5 update. After we and especially you, our community, are satisfied with the update, we will go directly to chapter 4. It will take a longer time to create the new chapter as well, but with the experience we have gained so far, things are getting better and better!

We are very much looking forward to your feedback!

Enjoy the time and have a nice holiday,
Dan and Andreas

notes.title: Chapter 3 News
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]
[hr][/hr]
As you surely know, we have announced the content update containing Chapter 3 for the end of November. For this, we have good and bad news, the good first. The update has become much more extensive than originally thought. The underground is much bigger than we had in concept. Due to the fact that the game world has become much larger, the update will unfortunately not be able to be released in November. We are developing as fast as we can, but we also want to do things well and thoroughly. The new date for the content update is around Christmas 2021. We are very sorry for the delay and we hope you can understand it!

This also means that the other chapters will take some time, so we won't be able to release Psych completely by the end of 2021. We guess that the new release date for all 5 chapters will be around February/March 2022.

Furthermore, we have invited two wonderful streamers to join Psych as voice actors. The two German streamers Gronkh and H0llyLP will be featured in the new update as a side story, if all goes according to plan.

Thank you so much for your support, for your patience and also for your incredible feedback that we can and will continue to use to improve Psych. We'll be in touch again when there's something new!
(Very soon)

– Dan and Andreas from MediaTale

notes.title: Chapter 3 Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/c76bab33aa8e1faaba1ca219a1905b3791233520.png[/img]

[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

notes.title: Update V0.2.0 – New content & bug fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Hello together![/h2]

We hope you had a good time at the Whine Vale Park while we were working on an update! This update brings some improvements as well as new things to discover. We were also able to fix some bugs thanks to your feedback. For all of you who can't wait for Chapter 3, here's what you need to know: Chapter 3 will be the biggest chapter yet with new locations to discover. We'll be putting significantly more horror into this chapter than the other two, so get ready for something!

[h3]New:[/h3]
- You will now find an incomplete map at the entrance to the park. You will find the individual map pieces scattered around the park, which you can then collect and bring to the map to complete it.
- New achievement to complete the map
- There are new secrets to discover in the park. Look out for the burning candles. They may lead you to a story if you do everything right.
- New achievement to find out the secret
- Once you reach the point where you need to find the key, "something or someone" will help you by pointing you in the right direction.
- Hard to read texts can now be read in clear letters for help
- Some horror elements have been improved
- Some parts of the park have been made more detailed to provide more immersion
- Someone had reported that you can now hear a chant near the pond when you do something specific

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
- The main menu now shows the correct version number
- The radius for hanging up the phone in the phone booth is now larger
- Fixed a bug where you could accidentally walk into a "shadow"
- Fixed a bug where conversations were interrupted by other voice lines.

[h3]Performance:[/h3]
-Audio files have been compressed to improve performance so that large amounts of data are no longer loaded on demand

notes.title: Update V0.1.1 – Bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
What an amazing start, you have overwhelmed us! We love hearing your feedback and watching your gameplay or streams! We found a few bugs that we fixed with this little update:

New:
- New option to invert mouse control
- The maximum brightness of the mobile phone light is now higher (controlled with the mouse wheel)

Fixed:
- Closing the eyes during a call results in having to open them again manually (instead of automatically)
- Clues to the puzzle with the electricity box improved
- Clearer instructions on what to do (Current Task)
- Adjusted the spawn from the key to the power house
- Passing out no longer leads to not being able to call Sam
- Fixed the double trigger from finding the power box
- Subtitles improved
- When you faint, you can no longer hold your mobile phone in your hand
- Misleading voice lines adjusted according to certain situations
- Fixed the brightness slider in the game (Only worked in the menu)
- The time from the mobile phone has been adjusted so that the hours are no longer repeated
- The interruption of voice lines in certain situations has been prevented
- Achievements are now unlocked in real time
- The Achievement "Tall Man In A Suit" has been fixed

We would like to thank you once again and hope that you will continue to give us lots of feedback! Feel free to write us your ideas!

notes.title: August Devlog
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We are almost done, only a few days until the release on 10th September 2021. It has already been almost one year since we decided to develop a horror game. At the beginning, there wasn't much planned, until it became more and more and before we knew it, we were already looking for the third voice actor. We managed to do a lot of things that we wouldn't be able to do by the 30. July 2021! 

[h2]Sprint[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Many of you have given us feedback on the movement. It seems a bit slow and you would like to be able to sprint. That's exactly what we have implemented!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/af4fbd6525d31cffa6959c6c06f92b384db513e2.gif[/img]

[h2]Save system[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The world, or rather the park of Psych, is open with its stories and mysteries, so you can pretty much go anywhere at any time. This was quite a challenge for the saving system, but nevertheless you can now save and load the game as expected!

[h2]Phone booth[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As you probably know, the phone booth in the park is quite a rarity. Unlike in the demo, you won't be allowed to enter a maximum of 3 digits, but you will be able to dial just about any number you can find in the course of development!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/2b88c38056d0b11e12172308c9d425305c6674cf.gif[/img]

[h2]Story[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
To make the story even more interactive, we have also added conversations that Alex can have on his mobile phone or even with other people in the park:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/7b7c395a32f899b6d728944616b0e7ab0c2d9b84.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/ab4e51315025eef5235b5c8afa274fefc02e848d.jpg[/img]

A big mechanic we're building on that will be there at release is the escalation system. Your senses get worse from time to time until you close your eyes and take a deep breath, but... do you really want to do that in the middle of a dark park?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/2f7c4e98f8c7aaa3fbb0165e87edff99262509f3.gif[/img]

Among other adjustments to graphics and atmosphere, as well as sound and environment, we have fixed various bugs. However, Psych will be an Early Access title, which means that there may still be bugs, but with your help we're sure we'll be able to fix them quickly. We're really looking forward to hearing your feedback and creating a game with you that won't be forgotten!

Dan & Andreas from MediaTale

[hr][/hr]
https://youtu.be/mzpcgJDFdN4
[url=https://twitter.com/MediaTaleAT style=button]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/mediataleat style=button]Instagram[/url]

notes.title: July Devlog
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

First of all, we would like to point out that we have postponed the release of Psych in the Early Access version from 30.07.2021 to 10.09.2021.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/99052656b7fe439b61bd6dbc65f675cc8a8cd1c1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Release Note[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As many of you know, there will be 5 chapters in Psych, the first 2 of which will be available to play on 10.09.2021 at the Early Access release. Originally, we wanted to release all 5 chapters in October 2021 at the latest, but the final release is consequently postponed indefinitely. We really want to take the time to develop a great, fresh and exciting story horror game together with you and especially based on your feedback.

[h2]Chapter Two[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Even though we are very far advanced in the development, we have not yet reached the quality where we ourselves are satisfied with it. Unlike in the demo, we have made the puzzle in the second chapter interactive and exciting. So you don't only have to look at what is happening, but also at the surroundings. The puzzle will not be complete at the beginning, it will be up to you to complete it and then solve it. At the same time, something will be lurking in the park. We won't reveal who or what, but let us assure you that it is not to be trifled with.

Dan & Andreas from MediaTale

By releasing the demo, we were able to get more than 2000 wishlists among the 7000 players, which helps us enormously in the development of Psych! We would like to thank everyone who played the demo and especially those who left feedback!

notes.title: March Devlog
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We would like to take this opportunity to thank all our supporters. We already have almost 500 wishlists on Steam and almost 500 Twitter followers, which is amazing! 

This month we have focused on content for Psych. We've divided Psych into 5 chapters that are immersively tied together without you noticing. We want to release two of the chapters for the first version, along with side stories, puzzles and secrets in the open world of Psych, and then make improvements based on your feedback.

We are also working on a [b]demo[/b] for the Steam Festival in June! So if you want, you can check out the demo first and then decide if you want to buy Psych! But here are the changes for March:

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Even though the graphics don't have such a strong focus, we want to make Psych a particularly attractive game. This month we have given the sky an update, which now shines with a moonlight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/5ef847590e4e747c1e7d886e6681a665137b5e99.jpg[/img]

notes.title: February Devlog
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

What an exciting month! We now have almost 400 wishlists, reached the Kickstarter goal for Psych and over 200 Twitter followers! We really thank you so much for your support! And not only that, we've also been able to accomplish quite a bit development-wise:


[h2]Menu[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We have changed the menu of Psych!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/0f2272bd324c11d16ff17a2087b2dcd70e4f9abc.jpg[/img]

What do you think? Feel free to write it in the comments!


[h2]Features[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
A lot has changed here! Let's start with the [b]notifications[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/301db7732350590c102b743abb9e665061d81703.jpg[/img]

In Psych, your smartphone is an important game element. Not only does it bring light into the darkness, but you also get important hints and messages that can guide your way. As a small gimmick, you now have the possibility to even change the background of your smartphone!

Let's continue with the [b]memories[/b]:
Due to the accident Alex can't remember what once was, so you have to help him with that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/2e98d17703fc6c8f1bbafa9f6fc26cc0dbccf13f.gif[/img]

Something causes Alex to painfully remember his past again, what is it?

[b]Escalation and Relieve System[/b]:
These are two unique systems in Psych that control your state of mind and govern your behavior. You have to be careful that your mental state is not too low, otherwise...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/2f7c4e98f8c7aaa3fbb0165e87edff99262509f3.gif[/img]


[h2]Graphic[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
This month we continued to improve the graphics with small details like the smartphone screen light, adjustments to textures and post-processing effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39303536/0a3887f77dec389de098bbb6f509a8e0e98dbc80.jpg[/img]

In addition, we made an important decision to redo the whole open world of Psych. By that we don't mean the layout or design, but when we created the project, we set the size from the terrain way too big, now this is hindering our creativity more and more. For this reason we decided to redo the whole map. Pretty much everything will stay the same, only we won't have any restrictions after that!


[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We have changed our website completely to english and improved the design! You are welcome to visit us at https://mediatale.at

We also uploaded the soundtrack of Psych on Youtube:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OfdhYC4Mk5M
Psych Teaser on Youtube:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UUj8HEbzex8
That's basically all for February! Stay tuned for more information and don't forget to visit us on Twitter. Stay healthy and see you soon!

notes.title: January Devlog
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who added Psych to their wishlist and supported us. We didn't expect so many wishlists in such a short time, just insane! With this devlog we want to present you the things we have been working on lately.

[h2]The Graphics[/h2]
